title: Determination of conjugated protein on nanoparticles by an adaptation of the Coomassie blue dye method
author: Oviedo, Quester, et al.

steps.title: Prepare nanoparticle-reagent mixture
steps.instruction: Weigh 50 mg of coated or uncoated nanoparticles into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add 900 µL distilled water, then add 100 µL Bio‑Rad protein assay reagent (amount calculated to give 0.5 absorbance units with excess protein).

steps.title: Incubate mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 8000 rpm for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and add BSA
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of the supernatant to a new test tube and add 36 µL of BSA solution (8 mg mL⁻¹) to provide excess protein.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of the mixture at 595 nm using a spectrophotometer; convert the absorbance to BSA equivalents (µg mL⁻¹) using the pre‑generated standard curve.

steps.title: Prepare control samples
steps.instruction: Prepare two controls: (a) mix 50 mg uncoated nanoparticles with 10 µL EDC and 890 µL distilled water; (b) mix 50 mg uncoated nanoparticles with 900 µL distilled water. Add 100 µL Bio‑Rad protein assay reagent to each control.

steps.title: Calculate bound protein
steps.instruction: Calculate the amount of protein bound to the nanoparticles using the equation: protein (µg) = 13.23 × [(Abs595 C) − (Abs595 NP)], where Abs595 C is the absorbance of the blank control (no nanoparticles) and Abs595 NP is the absorbance of the nanoparticle sample.
